label: onceEndsOnArrival: play-once ends as soon as the last frame shows, not after its time
startIgnored: the start frame's time is not added, so a late start plays from frame 0
pingPongNoReflect: ping-pong wraps like a loop instead of running back
find: frame: m <= last ? m : period - m

label: wholeRate: the clock counts the nominal whole rate, so 29.97 drifts to 30
